title: Hearty Pungent Australian Lettuce Stew
description: A pungent and chewy solo dinner dish from Australia featuring lettuce, cooked in a copper pot, inspired by Buddhist temple cuisine, and traditionally prepared in a ttukbaegi earthenware cook vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the lettuce, vegetable broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir well to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lettuce is tender, about 20 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
